market_summary: US stocks were roughly flat on Thu Nov 12 (intraday: S&P 500 +0.1%, Nasdaq ~0.0%, Dow +0.2%; final closes not yet confirmed), recovering after Nvidia fell as much as 13% on Jensen Huang's resignation before trimming to about -5%. The 10-year Treasury yield hit about 5.1%, up from 4.99%, after this week's hot CPI. Analysts say a December Fed hike is nearly fully priced, and some see a 50bp move. Semis were split (MU and INTC down, AMD up) and the SOX is still below its 200-day average, though Wednesday's CoreWeave beat showed AI capex demand holding up. WTI oil rose about 1.5% to the low $90s on Trump's Iran comments. Nvidia's Nov 17 results are the next test of AI capex, and Alibaba on Nov 19 is the China read.
